claim: Summer Jamboree 2026 (26th edition) runs 31 July to 9 August 2026, with 31 July as a pre-festival day.
quote: The festival runs July 31 - August 9, 2026, with July 31 designated as a prefestival event.

claim: Summer Jamboree is Europe's largest 1940s-50s American music and culture festival, covering Rock'n'Roll, Swing, Rockabilly, R&B, Doo-Wop, Hillbilly, Country and Boogie Woogie with concerts, social dancing (Lindy Hop, Boogie Woogie, Balboa, Jive), vintage markets, vintage cars and burlesque.
quote: Rock'n'Roll and Swing in all their forms: Rockabilly, Rhythm'n'Blues, Doo-Wop, Hillbilly, Country & Western Swing, Dixieland, Boogie Woogie and more.

claim: Summer Jamboree has drawn record crowds of around 400,000 presences over its ~10-day run, packing the town.
quote: Oltre 400.000 presenze a Senigallia per il Summer Jamboree

claim: The 2025 (25th) edition set new attendance records with the Rotonda a Mare sold out for ten nights.
quote: Summer Jamboree, l'edizione 25 da record. Migliaia di visitatori, Rotonda sold out per dieci serate

claim: CaterRaduno, the Radio2 Caterpillar fan rally hosted in Senigallia since 2007 (held in late June), left the town: it moved to Pesaro from 2022 after roughly twenty years.
quote: Ora è ufficiale: il Caterraduno dice addio a Senigallia, dal 2022 si trasferisce a Pesaro

claim: CaterRaduno was a week of live radio shows, concerts, guests, civil-battle talks and humour staged on the Velvet Beach in June.
quote: a week full of information, civil battles and biting humour ... concerts, guests, live radio shows, entertainment and fun on the Velvet Beach

claim: Pane Nostrum, Senigallia's international bread/leavened-products festival, is held at the Foro Annonario in the historic centre in late September (20-23 September 2026).
The Fiera di Sant'Agostino, a centuries-old market fair, fills the historic centre at the end of August (27-30 August) with over 500 exhibitors plus local-producer and organic sections.
The Festival del Cinema di Senigallia, run by the Confluenze association at the San Rocco Auditorium, takes place in October (12th edition 10-18 October 2025; 13th edition slated for October 2026).
quote: Si è conclusa con successo la XII edizione del Festival del Cinema di Senigallia

claim: The best time to visit Senigallia is May to September, with July-August the sunniest and liveliest (August averaging ~30C max) but also the busiest and priciest; late May-June and early September offer better value.
quote: The best time to visit Senigallia ... is during the summer months of June, July, and August ... August has an average maximum temperature of 30°C and is the warmest month
